question: Which bounded twice-held signed parity contradictions have operator readings, which can ordinary growth reach, and which full two-reader tables are quantum-realizable?
primary_observable: Per-pattern exact Pauli solvability versus the theorem and sharing criterion, exact whole-record reading tables, restored last-holder set and source-level funded and closing counts.
forbidden_inputs: No postselection on a reader's answers or an ordinary growth result. Do not use the external theorem as the Pauli solver. Freeze all sign and weighting conventions before outcomes.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Six-holder three-by-three comparison versus the six-holder three-place arrangement of matching size and the eight-holder negative table.
first_executable_signal: Check all 512 six-holder assignments and both tensor matrix products and Born traces.
resource_budget: One CPU per measured process, 4 GiB per process, seven-holder census, named panels and three ordinary steps as frozen.
stop_rule: Stop after classification and steps 2, 4, 5, or on a genuine mismatch after checking definitions.
decision_or_followup_rule: Preserve every result and send the completed exploration to an independent referee. No automatic promotion.
